one_liner: QuickBooks Online has a broad REST accounting API with OAuth 2.0 and a free developer account with sandbox. Reads are metered under the App Partner Program, and the free Builder tier is capped at 500k CorePlus calls per month.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 using a client ID and client secret from the developer portal. Each customer company (realm ID) must authorize the app individually. Token lifetimes in the draft (60-minute access tokens, 100-day refresh tokens) are not confirmed by the fetched pages.
access_notes: A free developer account gives a client ID, a client secret and a sandbox company. All apps are auto-enrolled in the uncharged Builder tier, which has 500k CorePlus (read) calls per month. Core (write) calls are free. The draft said production needs app assessment, but the fetched pages only mention an app assessment questionnaire as a tier requirement, so that claim is unverified.
blocker_notes: There is no hard blocker. Reads are metered, and the Builder tier is capped, so heavy read use needs a paid tier. The fetched pages do not confirm a mandatory production app review.

evidence.quote: Create a free account at the [Intuit Developer Portal]
Each of your clients' QuickBooks Online companies will need to individually connect and authorize your app through OAuth 2.0, since access is scoped per company
All apps are automatically enrolled in the Intuit App Partner Program at the Builder tier.
Overage: API calls are **blocked** after exceeding the 500,000 limit
The QuickBooks Online Accounting API gives you incredible flexibility to build creative solutions for key business and accounting workflows.
use [Intuit Developer Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/mcp-connector), an AI-enabled development environment.
